title: VTA Events — Invitations — Send — payload
description: A client invites contacts of the event's host the principal names: the VTA records each invitation and sends the invitee an event notification naming the host, and nothing else of the event. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

invitees.description: The contacts to invite, by the identifier each holds the relationship with the host under (VTI-PEV-010).

Response.title: VTA Events — Invitations — Send — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/invitations/send/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/invitations/send/0.1#response.

invitations.description: One per invitee, in request order. An invitee already invited answers the invitation held.
